subject: Re: Rerank model fit validation — NDCG/MRR and A/B plan
summary: Post-discovery follow-up documenting recommended rerank models, NDCG/MRR validation results, and proposed A/B plan. Internal alignment on next steps and requested sign-off from Acme to schedule pilot A/B test and share prompt sets.

Subject: Re: Discovery — Reranking for search results

Thanks for the call earlier — recap below and a couple quick questions.

Recap:
- Goal: improve relevance on product search by reranking top-K results from our retrieval layer; primary metrics: NDCG@10 and MRR.
- Traffic: ~2M queries/day, 95th p95 latency requirement <= 120ms for the rerank step.
- Constraints: must run in our VPC for PII filtering; preferring 8-bit quantized models.

Questions:
1) Which model variants do you recommend to start for a precision-oriented rerank?
2) Any concerns about quality regressions when moving from dense-only scoring to cross-attention rerank?

Attaching the initial evaluation snapshot we ran on a holdout set.

Attachments: [attachment: ndcg_mrr_results.csv]

Jorge

Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Alvarez <jorge@acme.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery — Reranking for search results

Hi Jorge — great meeting, thanks for the clear goals. High-level answers and next steps below.

Recommended starting models:
- small/fast baseline: bert-compact-8bit (good latency headroom for 95th p95)
- medium/quality: rerank-cross-7B-quant (balanced NDCG gains vs cost)
- high-quality (pilot): rerank-cross-13B-int8 (best NDCG but higher cost/latency)

Quality regression concerns:
- Cross-attention rerank will generally improve NDCG but can surface hallucinated context-dependent scores for out-of-distribution queries. We recommend evaluation on your production-like prompt sets and a focused regression suite.
- Use conservative thresholding and a fallback to baseline scoring on low-confidence inputs.

Initial validation plan (what we can run next week):
1) Run per-query NDCG@10 and MRR on your holdout (we can reuse the CSV you attached).
2) Produce precision/recall by intent buckets and surface failure clusters.
3) Proposed A/B: 20% traffic pilot, 2-week run, monitor NDCG delta, CTR, and latency SLOs.

I attached a draft A/B plan and the prompt sets we typically use for rerank evals. Michael will add the NDCG/MRR baseline numbers from our side. Can you confirm access to the Drive link below so we can upload the full eval outputs?

Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRerankBench
Attachments: [attachment: prompt_sets_v1.json], [attachment: rerank_ab_plan.pdf]

Next steps:
- Jorge: confirm Drive access and share any additional eval filters (time window, exact match rules).
- Acme: sign off on 20% pilot and NDA addendum for VPC deployment if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NDCG/MRR quick pass from our bench

Marissa — quick pass against Acme sample (attached). Highlights:
- rerank-cross-7B-quant: NDCG@10 +0.042 vs baseline; MRR +0.038. p<0.01 across 10k sample. Median latency: 78ms (single-GPU int8 path).
- rerank-cross-13B-int8: NDCG@10 +0.061; MRR +0.055. Median latency: 132ms (above their p95 target if left unbatched).

Notes / risks:
- 13B requires batching and/or half-precision kernels to meet p95 <= 120ms. If they need strict single-request p95, 7B is safer.
- Observed small regression for a narrow intent bucket (returns with many numeric tokens). We should add a regression test and consider a localized prompt engineering fix.

Suggested A/B configuration to propose:
- Variant A (control): existing dense-only re-score
- Variant B1 (trial): rerank-cross-7B-quant at 20% traffic
- Variant B2 (pilot): rerank-cross-13B-int8 at 5% (if latency mitigations approved)
- Metrics: NDCG@10, MRR, CTR on result click-through, and latency p95. Stop rules: any NDCG drop > 0.01 or latency p95 > 120ms for >24 hours.

I'll package the CSVs and the significance tests into the Drive folder.

Attachments: [attachment: ndcg_mrr_results.csv]

-Michael
Principal ML Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Keep rerank-cross-13B-int8 as B2 at 5% if you can accept batching mitigations; otherwise hold for a later expansion.
- Deliverables from Redwood for the pilot: full per-query NDCG/MRR results, significance tests, failure clusters, and the prompt/regression test suite.
